en: An old black‑and‑white postcard view of a small ornate classical pavilion or gate with arched openings and sculptural decorations, standing among tall trees in a park-like setting. To the right is a long, low building with arched windows. The word "Gulbene" is printed in red at the top of the image, and a small number appears in white in the lower left corner.
